# vITK (Voting Power)

This page is a redirect to the core concept: [Ai Proxy Optimism](ai-proxy-optimism.md).

**$vITK** is the non-transferable, on-chain voting power generated by locking native [Itk Token](../entities/itk-token.md) utility assets in the Xibalba DAO governance contracts. It is utilized autonomously by **Guardian Agents** within our infrastructure for the autonomous agent economy powered by smart contracts. On-chain settlement happens on Base L2.

*   Read the full guide: [Ai Proxy Optimism](ai-proxy-optimism.md)
*   See related systems: [Itk Token](../entities/itk-token.md), [Rust Oracle](../entities/rust-oracle.md)
